title: Fish Audio Drama 3 Leads All TTS Models in Pronunciation Robustness
summary:
The open weight system from Fish Audio has secured first place across three text to speech rankings from Artificial Analysis. Its Drama 3 Preview model scored 93.2% in Pronunciation Robustness, surpassing the scores of the closed source Eleven v4 and Eleven v4 Turbo models, which recorded 91.7% and 90.1% respectively. The 35B parameter mixture-of-experts model supports 83 languages and reached a Provider Voice Elo of 1,243, a 101 point gain over the company's previous S2.1 Pro.

The model is available on Hugging Face under the Fish Audio Community License and via an API priced at $15 per 1 million characters, compared to $80 per 1 million for Eleven v4. Designed for long-form content, the system enables users to adjust the emotion and tone of individual words using natural language instructions. Fish Audio currently serves more than 15M users and recently completed a $52M seed funding round.

selectedTweets.text:
Fish Audio's Drama 3 Preview is the new #1 open-weights Text to Speech model on the Artificial Analysis Text to Speech leaderboard. The model also leads all models in our Pronunciation Robustness leaderboard, ahead of Eleven v4 and Eleven v4 Turbo

Drama 3 Preview is the new open weights Text to Speech model from @FishAudio, built for multi-character scenes and long-form content with voice cloning and natural-language control. Weights are available on Hugging Face under the Fish Audio Community License.

Key takeaways:

➤ Pronunciation Robustness: Drama 3 Preview scores 93.2%, ranking #1 ahead of Eleven v4 at 91.7% and Eleven v4 Turbo at 90.1%. It ranks #1 in Standalone Terms and Preserving Exact Sequences and #2 in Expanding Shorthand.

➤ Provider Voice: Drama 3 Preview has an Elo of 1,243 (+16/-16) across 1,857 appearances, ranking #10, a 101 point gain on the previous Fish Audio S2.1 Pro at 1,142.

➤ Controlled Voice: Drama 3 Preview ranks #14 with an Elo of 1,058 (+15/-15) across 1,804 appearances.

➤ Open weights: Drama 3 Preview is the #1 open weights model on all three of our Text to Speech leaderboards. On Pronunciation Robustness it leads the next open weights model, Mistral's Voxtral TTS at 78.1%, by 15 points, and in the Provider Voice Arena it is ahead of Breeze TTS 2 at 1,221. Drama 3 is a 35B parameter mixture-of-experts model (3B active) supporting 83 languages, available on Hugging Face.

➤ Pricing: Drama 3 Preview is available via the Fish Audio API at $15/1M characters, the same as S2.1 Pro, compared to Eleven v4 at $80/1M characters and Eleven v4 Turbo at $40/1M characters.

selectedTweets.bestBit: Directions go inside square brackets in plain language, such as “barely holding it together,”
selectedTweets.text:
Really cool, open weight, TTS model, just dropped. 

Fixing one bad word in a TTS clip usually means regenerating the whole line, and the take you liked goes with it.

@FishAudio just released Drama 3, it's open-weight,  and the most emotive and controllable TTS model in the world

> lets users restyle single words mid-sentence

> Directions go inside square brackets in plain language, such as “barely holding it together,” and they can be written in English or the user’s own language.

> paired tags such as Whisper, Slower or Forceful wrap only the selected words, so a line can turn from steady to hushed halfway through.
